I started getting serious about learning English three and a half years ago, in April 2019.

During my student days, I spent time learning English, including compulsory education, attending private English cram schools, and needing a TOEIC score of 600 to advance in university. However, in reality, I remained in a state where I could occasionally get a good test score but couldn't speak at all.

Many Cambly tutors hold teaching certifications or English instruction qualifications. They are extremely good at grasping my intentions, and they provide me with time that is more than just 'practice for communicating through English'; it is time filled with learning.
The prices are, for example, as follows (I am someone who signed up with a 35% discount, so the prices shown are not the list prices, but the 35% off prices, sorry).
To be honest, 15 minutes of class time feels a bit short. I feel like I want to talk more, so 30 minutes a day would probably be best, but I'm currently living a somewhat busy daily life with work.
In times like that, a 15-minute course is great because you can review without feeling pressured! (I really want to emphasize this point...!)

With Cambly, lesson history is automatically recorded and can be viewed freely later. After taking a 15-minute lesson, I set aside time to review by watching the lesson video, and I make sure to write down phrases I couldn't say or new phrases I was taught in a notebook.
I think the regular price for Cambly is a bit of a brave decision, so if you're interested, I recommend aiming for the campaign periods that happen several times a year.

However, by engaging in English conversation daily, your ears and mouth get used to native pronunciation, speed, tempo, and vocabulary, and you gain experience. I've realized that in English conversation, the element of how confidently you can speak your own English is very important, so I think there is no better service than this for practicing to gain that confidence.

How I Use Cambly｜しょっさん
Overcoming my fear of English
I started online English conversation lessons on Cambly in October 2022 to overcome my fear of English.
I have written about why I chose Cambly on note before.
My goal for the last year or two in particular has been to
get rid of my anxiety when speaking with native speakers!

Having worked for an international NGO, I used English to work with non-native speakers in places like Southeast Asia, so I felt I could manage the minimum communication required for work. However, when interacting with native speakers, I always felt intimidated by the vast difference in the number of words I used and the many phrases I couldn't understand.
To overcome this weakness, today I will talk about how I use Cambly.
